Mission Possible Partnership (2022). Steel sector transition strategy model (MPP Steel TSSM): workbooks 'CAPEX OPEX Per Technology.xlsx' and 'CCS Model.xlsx'. Mission Possible Partnership. No DOI or URL printed in the workbooks.

Year 2022 from file properties (CAPEX OPEX created 2021-11-02, last modified 2022-02-04; CCS Model created 2022-01-07, last modified 2022-07-18); no publication year printed. CAPEX OPEX Per Technology.xlsx (sheets GF capex, Renewal capex, Other Opex; 21 routes x 2020-2050, one global series, no regions): loaded 2020 greenfield capex, 2020 Other Opex (as opex-fixed) and 2020 renewal capex (separate process and '-renewal' technology, COST BASIS: incremental) for 21 routes; 2021-2050 values for the routes whose values change go to _projections.csv (the rest are flat 2020-2050); 'Close plant' (not a technology) to _other-values.csv. CCS Model.xlsx (Transport, Storage, Capture, Constraint): nothing loaded to a main file. Capture costs (USD/tCO2 by flow type Pure Flow / Mixed Flow / Point Source / DAC) are given only for 11 regions with no global or default region flagged, so per the one-region rule none was chosen; all years/regions go to mpp_2022_steel-ccs-model_other-values.csv, as do transport costs (onshore/offshore pipeline, shipping; by capacity, cost case, region, 'Node' 1-3), storage costs (by location, type, legacy-well reuse, Low/Medium/High) and the cumulative storage-capacity constraint (Mt, Low/High scenario).

1. No price year stated anywhere in either workbook; units written as USD without a year. 2. CAPEX OPEX workbook prints no units or currency at all; USD taken from the companion CCS workbook of the same model, per t of annual crude-steel capacity (capex) and per t crude steel (opex) not printed. 3. Cost basis (what the capex covers, which process units are in each route) not stated. 4. 'Other Opex' is not defined as fixed or variable, nor are its components stated. 5. 'Renewal capex' is not defined (assumed refurbishment of an existing plant from the sheet name). 6. Routes are named only (e.g. 'DRI-EAF' does not state the reducing gas; 'EAF' does not state the charge); no descriptions. 7. CCS Transport 'Node 1/2/3' and Storage 'Costs -  capacity 5' are undefined; storage capacity unit not printed. 8. Capture costs have no global/default region; flow-type categories are not defined or tied to steel routes. 9. Region lists differ between sheets (Capture/Constraint use 11 model regions; Transport/Storage use 18 regions incl. 'Global' and 'Canada'). 10. Some routes carry identical values across variants (e.g. DRI-EAF, DRI-EAF_50% bio-CH4, DRI-EAF_50% green H2, DRI-EAF_100% green H2 all 698.34 greenfield), suggesting shared placeholders.
